title: Pulse Polio drive from June 28; drops for children under five at 1,937 centres in Tirupati
summary: Drops will be given at 1,937 centres in the district on Sunday, with door-to-door visits by staff on Monday and Tuesday to reach children missed at the centres

title: VB-G RAM G will guarantee only centralisation, financial stress on States: Congress
summary: Jairam Ramesh said the PM Modi Government, "vengeful and petty" as ever, bulldozed the repeal of MGNREGA through Parliament without any thorough consultation with the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Rural Development, State governments, or other relevant stakeholders

title: Hypoxia likely killed thousands of fish on Anakapalli coast, says CMFRI study
summary: About 11 tonnes of fish, mostly pony fish, washed up along a 1,500-metre stretch at Boyapadu; a CMFRI study links the deaths to an algal bloom and oxygen depletion

title: Madhav calls for sustainable solution to Chittoor mango farmers’ woes
summary: The recurring crisis being faced by the farmers every season highlights the urgency of structural reforms in the horticulture sector, says the BJP State president

title: Telangana rolls out Pulse Polio campaign with target to vaccinate over 40 lakh children
summary: Though there have been no polio cases for over a decade now, we still need to take precautions to maintain it that way, says Health Minister C. Damodar Raja Narasimha

title: Resign and join RSS, Raj Thackeray slams feted IPS officer
summary: If you feel affection for the Sangh, keep it in your heart, or if you want to speak about it publicly, then resign from service and join the Sangh or the BJP, says Maharashtra Navnirman Sena chief Raj Thackeray

title: YSRCP’s fight is for power and ours is for public service, says A.P. Minister Kandula Durgesh
summary: Tourism Minister accuses YSRCP of consistently opposing the capital city and attempting to provoke people through irresponsible statements

title: Deputy CM condoles farmer’s death in elephant attack in Tirupati
summary: The Deputy Chief Minister asked forest officials and the Tirupati administration to visit the family of B. Thimma Reddy and release compensation at once
